result.summary: The page layout is mostly sound, but the 'Fastest near you' carousel shows a duplicated restaurant entry, and the favorite (heart) button styling is inconsistent between the two 'Popular right now' cards.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' carousel shows two identical 'Green Bowl Poké' cards (same image, same 15–25 min ETA, same €0.90 delivery fee) side by side, which looks like a duplicated data entry rather than two distinct restaurants.
issues.suggestion: De-duplicate the restaurant list by unique ID before rendering the carousel, or differentiate the entries (e.g. distinct branch names/addresses) if they really are separate locations.

issues.description: The favorite heart buttons on the two 'Popular right now' cards use different treatments: the ramen card has a white circular button with a dark outline heart, while the pizza card has a dark/transparent circular button with a white outline heart.
issues.suggestion: Use a single consistent favorite-button style (same background, icon color and opacity) across all restaurant cards, ideally with a scrim to guarantee contrast on any image.

issues.description: Promo/metadata badges such as '€0 delivery', '−20%' and the ETA pills rely on small text over photographic backgrounds; the '−20%' badge in particular sits over a bright image, reducing legibility.
issues.suggestion: Add a solid or semi-opaque badge background and verify at least 4.5:1 contrast for badge text over all card imagery.
